subnames.description: One is picked per fish: Rainbow Trout, Northern Pike.

size.description: In whole centimetres. Split into six equal slices, one per size band (R3.3).

rift.description: A fish from another world, found only in the spots' rift tables, through the wizard's Rift Fishing (D104).

difficulty.description: Added to the size band's difficulty.

stew.description: What this fish adds to the perpetual stew's buff, and what eating it gives (R19.4, R21.1).

plants.description: How it keeps to water plants (D150), from FishBase: `lives` among them, `spawns` on them. At a spot where plants grow, it is likelier: always if it lives there, while spawning (D149) if it spawns there.

spawn.description: When it spawns (D149): the water's temperature, on the weather's scale (0 extremely cold to 15 and up extremely hot; about 2 °C a step), from min to max, and whether it spawns as the water warms or cools. Spawning fish gather.

swim.description: How it moves when drawn swimming (D147): its easy speed in pixels a second; the chance it holds still at each new goal (a pike waiting, a trout holding against the current); the chance of a burst, and how many times its easy speed a burst is; how far it winds up and down as it goes, in pixels (an eel).

lengthWeight.description: Its weight from its length (D146): W = a × L^b, grams and centimetres of total length, from FishBase. `from`: the species the numbers are for, when a relative's were borrowed or for the record.

fights.description: How it fights on the line (D141): its style in rules/fight-styles.json tilts the roll by how the player struck.

fighter.description: A famous fighter (D141): its manoeuvre, a second beat after the strike, is much likelier.

endangered.description: An endangered fish (D140): letting one go pays a character with the Conservationist perk (rules/conservation.json). Two per spot, and a few rift fish.

taste.description: How it eats (D138): a bowl of stew lasts longer or shorter for it, and so does its buff eaten raw (rules/stew.json). Plain if left out.

tasteLine.description: A sentence on how it eats, shown once the player has eaten one (D138).

parasites.description: The risk in eating it raw (Sushi enjoyer, D138): the chance of the Queasy debuff is in rules/stew.json. Leave out for none: sea fish and rift fish.

rarity.description: The species' rarity; the size band shifts it (D49, D63).

swims.description: Which quarter of the water it keeps to, side on (the aquarium, the dive, the title): where the real fish spends most of its time (D136).

prefers.description: When the fish is likelier (D101): each preference the moment meets multiplies its weight in a table by the factor in rules/fish-preferences.json. Leave one out for no preference ("Any").
